lines.text: This thirty dollar fake Makita claims almost twice the torque of the real one.
ai: two teal cordless impact wrenches facing each other on a dark workbench with dramatic light

lines.text: And the real one costs 138 dollars so on paper you'd be crazy to pay five times more.
ai: a stack of dollar bills next to a cheap cordless impact wrench
a man holding his head in disbelief silhouette

lines.text: They even weigh the same down to one single gram.
ai: two power tools balanced on an old brass scale

lines.text: But on the torque rig the fake makes just 91 foot pounds.
ai: a cordless impact wrench struggling on a big bolt with sparks

lines.text: That's less than a quarter of what the box promised so the spec sheet is basically fan fiction.
ai: a glossy product box with a giant exaggerated torque number glowing
a fantasy book glowing with magic on a workbench

lines.text: And the real Makita hits 178 out of its promised 210.
ai: a teal impact wrench spinning a lug nut with motion blur

lines.text: Because inside an impact wrench a spinning hammer slams the anvil thousands of times a minute.
ai: cutaway inside an impact wrench showing a spinning steel hammer hitting an anvil
macro of two steel blocks colliding with sparks
slow motion steel hammer striking metal with a shockwave

lines.text: And the Makita's hammer is 44 grams heavier and spins faster so every hit carries more energy.
ai: two steel hammer parts side by side on a scale macro
a heavy steel part spinning fast with motion trails

lines.text: So it pulls lug nuts in 35 seconds instead of 49 which is almost a third faster.
ai: a lug nut flying off a car wheel in slow motion

lines.text: Then he drops both onto an anvil and the fake's handle snaps.
ai: a black plastic tool handle shattering into pieces slow motion

lines.text: But thirty bucks for a brushless motor is still a crazy good deal.
ai: a glowing copper brushless electric motor macro
a small pile of thirty dollars in cash under a spotlight

lines.text: So would you pay five times more for the real one?
ai: two teal cordless impact wrenches facing each other on a dark workbench with dramatic light
